scope: direct index startup; daemon measured separately

daemon.note: daemon process memory includes the resident engine and is not comparable to the direct CLI process RSS/PSS

correctness: fast path requires indexed manifest, existing storage, matching generation/index version and clean-scan fingerprint
clean-scan sidecar is written only after a successful index when pre/post fingerprints match
explicit changes, rebuild, scan/model options, skipped files and missing storage bypass fast path
delete and one-file-change tests refresh the sidecar
ZGM2 manifests remain 2000/2000, no legacy JSON manifests
limits: single host/single run per incremental/rebuild condition
no OS page-cache drop; cold I/O not forced
daemon comparison is client latency plus resident daemon PSS, not direct process RSS
